confidence_notes: Recent city averages are a proxy for July meals, cappuccino and a pint of draft beer. Local benchmarks put a standard cocktail well above beer and a glass of house wine close to it. July lodging is modeled and varies by neighborhood and booking lead time. [Numbeo Lisbon](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Lisbon) and [Expat-U drink benchmarks](https://expat-u.com/nightlife-in-lisbon/).
comparable_city_reasoning: Porto provides a regional reference for Portuguese dining prices. The lodging estimates reflect Lisbon's larger visitor market and peak summer demand.
